interpretation: QueueT is the user-confirmed human. His three recorded wins ended at ticks186,291,245 without our side ever observing his general. Other online names do not establish human identity.

In QueueT game5 the thirteen advances from tick156 through168 did reveal35 previously unseen cells in the following observations. The column fell from53 to14 troops. The issue is reconnaissance cost and usable terminal force, not literally zero exploration.

The resource-claim trial improved on the first forced dispatcher but remained96/160 versus the retained control119/160. Its first eighty actual games still had547 large immediate reversals without collection/new vision; that descriptive label is not proof every reversal was bad.

The complete-defence programme passed its regression and finished111/160, with two flipped wins and ten flipped losses versus the control. This regression fix alone does not establish a strength gain.

Strict king-relief pricing alone failed the historical probe because owned-path-only reinforcement misses attrition on the approach. Applying interception to only the direct-campaign generators also failed: the occupation generator offered the same unfunded target.

The common terminal check simulates every remaining order, subtracts actual approach casualties once, and tests a visible off-route interception as an alternative to home reinforcement. It does not constitute exhaustive opponent search or proof of human-level play.

All alternative probes use the original subsequent observations; their actions were not executed and their choices cannot be counted as alternate wins. Paired game-level p-values also ignore correlations within rotated maps.

next_questions: Measure which rejected general approaches could force a valuable defender response or concede a productive city. A complete direct capture is not the only useful outcome; replacing its false elimination prize with zero may suppress valid pressure. This is an untested explanation for the regression, not an established cause.

QueueT spent a first wave to obtain our general location and then delivered another concentrated wave. The failed forced-dispatch experiments retained an arbitrary fraction of the starting force, which is not equivalent to planning a useful reconnaissance mission. Compare the posterior target information reached and the next deployable force, not raw newly seen cells or a fixed survival threshold.

land_tenure_and_supply_followup.next_design_question: Represent a sortie as a persistent military and information investment anchored at real assembly, accounting for cumulative depletion, the next land-income deadline, protected production and a feasible regrouping route. Assess when to finish or abandon that investment without resetting its loss budget every one-step capture. Earlier forced-role drafts regressed and must not be reintroduced merely by changing thresholds.
